title: Chapter 233 Five-Star Zerg Mother Nest
content:
Chapter 233 Five-Star Zerg Mother Nest

The 50,000 liquid fireball shells fired by the Zerg destroyers made the commander of the alien army look very different, and ordered all interception forces to intercept with all their strength.

"Boom...!"

The terrible explosion affected most of the alien army.

The continuous explosions and accumulated damage caused a large increase in casualties in the alien army.

This alien army is worthy of being a powerful army of a super clan. Facing such an attack without any ability to fight back, the entire army's phalanx can still maintain stability and order, and fall into chaos.

The injured alien soldiers were all very calm. They stood up, stepped on the corrosive mucus all over the ground, and continued to perform their duties and execute combat orders.

The alien priests who followed the army continued to perform purification magic to remove the corrosive mucus on the alien soldiers and the ground, which could also speed up the self-healing and recovery of the soldiers who also practiced light attribute energy.

With the assistance of a large number of alien priests accompanying the army, the losses of the alien army were greatly reduced.

However, no matter how powerful the army is, it will eventually collapse in the face of such an endless and powerful attack.

The alien army will not sit still and wait for death.

When the Zerg army entered the battlefield area, the battlefield reconnaissance personnel of the alien army had observed the situation of the Zerg army and immediately reported the intelligence.

Without saying a word, all the siege weapons in the army were fiercely output in the direction of the Zerg army.

Some of the siege weapons in the alien army have a very long range, but most of them cannot reach the current location of the Zerg army.

This is not a mistake of the alien army, it is their intention.

In front of the Zerg army, there are still many local camp troops fighting with the alien army. They have obtained the ultra-long-range attack support of the Zerg destroyers in the rear, and they are eager to fight, and have no intention of giving way to the Zerg army.

They basically took over the full output of the alien army's siege weapons in this round.

This was really an unexpected disaster. The ultimate firepower output unit of the entire alien army focused all its fire on them, and the result was quite tragic.

The hundreds of thousands of local camp troops in front of the Zerg army were defeated at once and had no choice but to organize a retreat.

Fortunately, the troops that could go to this battlefield were not a mob. They did not collapse and attack the Zerg army's square formation. Instead, they began to withdraw from the battlefield from both sides in a relatively orderly manner, and dared not stand in front of the Zerg army, this terrible ally.

Otherwise, whoever dared to attack the Zerg army's formation would be killed by the Zerg army without hesitation.

The attack launched by the alien army's siege weapons eventually fell on the Zerg army's square formation, which was very limited, causing some wounded in the Zerg army, but the impact was not great.

The local camp's army was forced to give up the battlefield space in front, but the Zerg army did not need to continue to close the distance with the alien army for the time being.

The Zerg army was at an absolute disadvantage in terms of manpower. With the advantage of ultra-long-range attacks, there was no need to move forward.

Wu Qing planned to use the Zerg destroyer to break the rock-solid formation of the alien army, so that they could not bear it and mobilized themselves, and then look for opportunities to destroy their manpower.

The Zerg army provided ultra-long-range powerful firepower attacks, successfully attracting the attention of the alien army, which also created opportunities for the armies of other races in the local camp that were besieging the alien army.

Now it depends on whether they can seize this opportunity.

The local camp army that can insist on attacking the alien army under disadvantages must be courageous and brave.

The attack of the Zerg destroyer has tied down most of the long-range attack power of the alien army, allowing the besieged local camp army to rush up with more melee forces and engage in close combat with the alien army.

"Boom boom boom...!"

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg destroyers continued to attack. Fifty thousand liquid fireball shells fired by Zerg destroyers with a minimum strength of two stars at a time illuminated the sky above the alien army.

The alien army's interception was becoming increasingly weak, allowing more liquid fireballs to fall into the army formation, bringing death, pain and disorder.

Once dead, they were sacrificed by the enemy, which was absolutely unbearable for believers of the Lord of Light!

The alien army began to act against the Zerg army.

The local camp army that besieged the alien army was originally surrounded. Now the local camp army in this direction of the Zerg army was attacked by the alien army and could not bear it, so they were retreating.

This opened a gap in the encirclement, allowing the Zerg army to face the alien army directly.

This was exactly the purpose of the alien army. What they wanted to eliminate most now was the Zerg heretics.

In order to avoid the huge liquid fireballs in the sky, the flying corps of the alien race, the Light Griffin, has already flown high into the sky, swooping down from time to time to spray energy balls to assist the ground forces in intercepting the attacks of the Zerg destroyers.

The name of the Light Griffin was heard by the Zerg host from the friendly forces nearby.

The word "light" is the original meaning of the language of this world, and the name "Griffin" originally referred to something Wu Qing did not go into it, so he turned to the book and translated it into the name he was familiar with.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

In Wu Qing and the Zerg, this kind of flying soldier of the alien race is called the Light Griffin.

These Light Griffins, while assisting in interception, are ready to attack the Zerg army from the air at any time.

The four-star Zerg host in the sky observed that there were many powerful human mages with particularly strong elemental energy in the alien army. They did not intercept the attack of the Zerg destroyer, but gathered together, as if making some preparations.

"Forbidden spell magic? Large-scale war magic? Or what?"

"In the battle between armies, the strong will not take action?"

When Wu Qing saw this situation, he suddenly thought of the ability of the magician in the Western fantasy novel he had read before. The Zerg host could already sense the abnormal state of energy between heaven and earth in the area where the alien mages gathered.

No strong people intervened in this, indicating that this was an attack mode within the rules.

Wu Qing must not let this kind of thing develop.

"Queen, take action and kill them!"

Wu Qing ordered.

There are less than a hundred powerful human mages, and their strength should not exceed that of a five-star or four-star Zerg queen. The spawning attack is enough to kill them in one blow.

The Zerg queen hidden in the Zerg flying dragon group quietly launched a spawning attack on the powerful human mages who were guarded by the layers of the alien human army in the distance. The number of one hundred Zerg queens is enough to deal with all the powerful human mages at once.

A string of magical spores, through mysterious means, crossed the ultra-long distance space, ignored various powerful defenses, and silently invaded the bodies of the powerful human mages.

In an instant, the energy of the heaven and earth where the powerful human mages gathered suddenly vibrated out of control, and then gradually calmed down.

The powerful human mages who were originally controlling these energies all changed their faces, from shock, unwillingness, and disbelief to pain, despair, and hideous faces!

Their faces were like Sichuan opera face-changing, leaving the guards guarding on the side at a loss.

No one knew what happened!

"Pah, pah, pah..."

Almost at the same time, with dense crisp sounds, the bodies of nearly a hundred powerful alien mages all exploded!

When the alien mages died, everything in their bodies turned into light and disappeared!

This sudden change not only scared the guards around, but also shocked the few people who were able to observe and pay attention to the situation here!

"Who shot it!?"

"So hidden? There is no trace at all!"

This is the question in everyone's mind.

Wu Qing suddenly sensed that there were several dangerous auras in the direction of the evil god camp and the local camp, and they disappeared quickly.

What surprised Wu Qing was that this group of alien mages were all real strong men in the alien army, and they should all have five-star strength!

The Zerg Queen killed nearly a hundred people with this move, directly meeting the conditions for the Zerg mother nest to upgrade to five stars!

"Five-star strong men appeared in groups, no wonder this army is so strong!"

Wu Qing couldn't help but sigh.

This group of nearly 100 five-star mages from the alien race had not made any move. This move must have been a powerful and earth-shattering attack, and it was definitely aimed at the Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army.

Fortunately, the Zerg has a strong ability to control the battlefield, and has a powerful means of killing with one blow, which saved the Zerg army from a major loss.

As soon as the Zerg arrived in the outside world, the upper limit of the strength of the enemies they encountered was instantly raised to a very high level.

The Zerg, whose highest strength is only four stars, seemed a bit embarrassing.

Without time to hesitate, Wu Qing's consciousness instantly returned to the main body, and immediately selected the four-star Zerg mother nest for upgrade.

When the mother nest is upgraded to a star level, the strength of the Zerg can be comprehensively improved, but the resources consumed are very few. This can be said to be one of the biggest benefits provided by the system!

After the Zerg mother nest is upgraded, the upgrade options of all Zerg buildings will be refreshed, so as to obtain an opportunity to continue upgrading, which plays a vital role in improving the strength of the Zerg army.

When the Zerg mother nest is upgraded to five stars, the strength of the Zerg troops fighting on the battlefield can be directly upgraded to five stars by consuming resources.

The four-star Zerg nest where Wu Qing's body was located was soon upgraded to a five-star nest, and all the buildings with upgrade options in the Zerg territory were given an upgrade opportunity.

Wu Qing selected the nest, hatchery, evolution chamber, air force tower, queen's nest and other buildings one by one and upgraded them all.

Across a long distance, the Zerg army fighting on the public battlefield in the southern theater of war instantly changed its combat power.
